name: After recital 2
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council amending Regulation (EU) 2023/956 as regards simplifying and strengthening the carbon border adjustment mechanism
part_text: (2 a) In order to avoid exacerbating distortions of competition, simplifications and exemptions at least equivalent to those granted to importers should be adopted in the emissions trading system (EU ETS) for companies producing in Europe.
